Fintech · Australia

Beforepay

Pay On Demand for working Australians — migrated from two native apps to Flutter.

My role
Lead mobile engineer
Client
Beforepay via Cefalo
Timeline
Oct 2023 – present
Platform
Android, iOS → Flutter

Overview

Beforepay’s Pay On Demand lets working Australians access part of their wages before payday for a fixed 5% fee. Two native codebases meant every feature was built twice — and the apps drifted.

What I owned

  • →Designed the native‑to‑Flutter migration strategy across iOS and Android
  • →Wrote the Flutter vs Kotlin Multiplatform RFC that set the long‑term platform direction
  • →Built Method Channel bridges so legacy modules kept running during migration

Key decision

Migrate incrementally behind bridges instead of a rewrite — the app moves money, so releases could never stop.
